name: Shell Foundation
program: Partnerships (invite-only) and announced calls for applications
collect_note: Shell Foundation has no standing call list, but when it opens applications (for example the ClimaFii Alliance cohorts) it announces it in its press-release section, which the twice-daily run reads through the site's WordPress API and keeps only items whose title announces open applications, a call or request for proposals; they wait for review, and the announcement carries no closing date. The engine has no age cut-off, so an old announcement without a closing date reads as open until a person rejects it.

sample.title: Shell Foundation and Accion open applications for ClimaFii Alliance second cohort

evidence: GET https://shellfoundation.org/wp-json/wp/v2/press-release?per_page=100 HTTP 200 (25 items, newest 2026-11-05); the 2025-12-11 item 'open applications for ClimaFii Alliance second cohort' states 'announced the opening of applications' (no closing date); older calls in posts type: 'ClimaFii Alliance issues call for clean energy applications' (2025-01-30), 'Seeking proposals for new health electrification finance mechanisms' (2021-03-03), 'Call for sustainable urban mobility start-ups in Kenya and Uganda' (2020-03-10). /feed/ (RSS) holds thought-leadership news only, no call items; /wp-json/wp/v2/types has no call type; sitemap.xml has post, page, press-release, media-coverage sections only. Checked 2026-11-12.
